name: Quick Commands
description:
Short commands to help with repetive and/or annoying things to write frequently such as timestamps.

Each command starts with a backslash (\) and a single word for the command. Select the autocomplete option you desire and the command text will be replace.

Default commands are: today, tomorrow, yesterday, now, week.

Custom commands can also be specified. Each line starts with the command name followed by one or more replacement values separated by spaces. Enclose multi-word values in double quotes, for example: myname "Firstname Lastname". Date and time values can be substituted with {dd}, {MM} and so on.

Replacement values may have escaped newlines "\n" and Unicode characters in the form "\uXXXX".
